name: Cosplay! Kyonyuu Mahjong
original_name: こすぷれ！きょにゅー麻雀
source:
Playing mahjong while cosplaying at the school festival!? If you lose, you have to fulfill the winner one wish!
Will you be able to spend the school festival safely? What is the ending that awaits you?
translation:
在学园祭上，一边角色扮演，一边打麻将？！输了的人，必须答应赢家一个愿望！
你能平安度过这场学园祭吗？等待你的，又会是怎样的结局？
